newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman to spend $520 million on expanding airport.
newsitem.headline: Oman to spend $520 million on expanding airport.

text.p: Communications minister Salem bin Abdullah al-Ghazali said on Wednesday Oman planned to spend 200 million rials ($519.5 million) on expanding the capital's Seeb airport to handle growing passenger traffic.
He told reporters the private sector would finance the construction of a new complex and would run it. The government would continue to handle immigration and aviation control.
Ghazali said a consultant had completed a study of the project and found it feasible. Seeb is set to meet capacity by 1998 despite recent expansion work.
